svg.title: The peoples of Genesis 10
svg.desc: A map of the Near East and eastern Mediterranean showing where the peoples named in the Table of Nations (Genesis 10) are thought to have lived, coloured by Noah's three sons, with the route of Terah and Abram from Ur to Haran and into Canaan. Green marks land watered by rain or river (today's climate: Köppen-Geiger, Beck et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0); the blank middle is the Syrian and Arabian desert.

g.text: where they are thought to have lived
